title: viola sepincola var. beraudii
intro: Viola sepincola var. beraudii, commonly known as the yellow violet, is a plant species belonging to the Violaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Viola sepincola var. beraudii include soothing and calming effects, which can help to reduce stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
